passages.note: Aye on Assembly concurrence in Senate amendments, the final Assembly vote on the chaptered text; 16 of 77 voting No, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Operative Section 220.5 forbids local rules requiring disclosure without consent; Section 220.3 only says staff shall not be required to disclose, so it does not require staff to withhold (rung 1 excluded).

rows.reasoning: Calderon voted Aye on final Assembly concurrence in AB 1955 (2023-2024), a single-subject pupil-privacy bill whose operative Section 220.5 bars schools from enacting or enforcing any policy that would require staff to disclose a pupil's gender identity without the pupil's consent. That matches "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents"; the bill does not require staff to keep the information from parents, so it does not reach "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents."
